title: 10 Best Short Anime You Can Rewatch Anytime
content: Long-running anime series with multiple seasons that have been released over the years have been dominating the industry for the past few years. Most of these series gather a wide global fanbase throughout their run since they manage to steal the spotlight with each new season.

title: Witch Hat Atelier Anime Reveals 2 More Cast Members
content: The staff for the television anime of Kamome Shirahama 's Witch Hat Atelier manga announced two additional cast members on Monday. They appear in the 10th and 11th episodes on June 8 and June 15, respectively. Ayumu Watanabe ( Ace Attorney , Doraemon films) is directing the anime at BUG FILMS .

title: Chiikawa Anime Film's Trailer Reveals Cast, Opening Theme Song

title: Witch Hat Atelier Casts Ryusei Nakao and Hiiro Ishibashi as Sasaran and Euini
content: Witch Hat Atelier has announced two new cast additions ahead of the anime’s upcoming Second Pentagram Test Arc . Veteran voice actor Ryusei Nakao will voice the Brimmed Cap member Sasaran, while Hiiro Ishibashi has been cast as Euini.
